generated_for: SENSOR-B4-I17 BLOC 5 HANDOFF - frozen normalization ownership split
non_negotiable_boundary: Bloc 4 never performs normalization. It never converts units, never computes notional, never assigns a canonical asset, and never assigns effective_at. If a future change requires Bloc 4 to do any of these, that change is out of contract and requires a separately authorized checkpoint.
rule: No capability is claimed by both blocs and no capability is claimed by neither. Where an answer could belong to either, it is listed under the bloc that must MAKE the decision and is marked decision_owned.

shared_decision_points.resolution: Default is ERROR_ON_AMBIGUITY (Bloc 4 enforces the fail-closed default); Bloc 5 must change it deliberately and record it.
Bloc 4 exposes the options (ReplayOrder); Bloc 5 selects and records one. Default ACQUISITION_ORDER is ingestion order, not event-time order.
Bloc 4 provides IntegrityState and integrity_minimum; Bloc 5 chooses its minimum for a given pass.
